title: Sampling headroom is not selection gain: a compute-value audit of test-time scaling for video world models
abstract: arXiv:2609.13257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) can improve generation only when additional compute produces better candidates and the system can reliably identify them. This distinction is especially important for video world models, where a wider sample pool may contain stronger rollouts without improving the output that is ultimately selected. We introduce the Compute-Value Audit (CVA), a sequential framework that asks whether extra sampling creates opportunity, observable signals provide a reliable state, that state supports a beneficial action, and the resulting gain exceeds the full entry fee of generation and verification. On 192 Physics-IQ scenes, expanding the pool from 4 to 16 candidates increases oracle quality by +9.23 IQ (95% CI [+7.44, +11.14]), but Flow, Cycle, and VideoReward fail to recover this headroom reliably. translated_title: 采样余量不等于选择增益：视频世界模型测试时扩展的计算价值审计
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展只有在额外计算能够产生更好的候选结果、且系统能够可靠地识别出这些候选时，才能真正改进生成。这一区别对于视频世界模型尤为重要：更宽的样本池中可能包含更强的生成轨迹，却并不一定会改进最终被选中的输出。我们提出了计算价值审计（Compute-Value Audit, CVA），这是一个序列化框架，依次追问：额外采样是否创造了机会、可观测信号是否提供了可靠的状态、该状态是否支持有益的行动，以及由此产生的增益是否超过生成与验证的全部入场成本。在192个Physics-IQ场景上，将候选池从4个扩展到16个使oracle质量提升了+9.23 IQ（95%置信区间[+7.44, +11.14]），但Flow、Cycle和VideoReward三种验证器都无法可靠地回收这一余量。在三个生成器上，十二种自适应深度策略中没有一种能超过均匀计算分配；它们仅回收了可测余量的42%至69%。
tldr: 论文提出计算价值审计框架，揭示视频世界模型的测试时扩展中“扩大采样池”并不等于“选择增益”——现有验证器无法可靠识别最优候选，且所有自适应计算策略均不如均匀分配。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Compute-Value Audit (CVA) framework, showing that in test-time scaling for video world models, a larger sample pool creates headroom but existing verifiers cannot reliably capture it, and all adaptive-depth compute policies underperform uniform allocation.
